create_TimingScriptGenerator: create a TimingScriptGenerator instance to generate a bash script that invokes and times the toy compiler
build_TimingScriptGenerator_writeTimingC: build timing calls for MCJIT and JIT modes using TimingScriptGenerator.writeTimingCall with IR and call file names
create_LibScriptGenerator: create a LibScriptGenerator instance to generate a bash script for invoking the toy module dumper
build_LibScriptGenerator_writeLibGenCall: build library generation calls using LibScriptGenerator.writeLibGenCall with library and IR file names
run_splitScript: run splitScript to split a Kaleidoscope input file into library and call parts with timing and lib generation scripts
